takes.title: Standing tucked backflip
takes.actionDescription: The performer swings the arms back and crouches, tucks tightly through a backward flip, and lands bent forward before standing.

takes.sourceDescription: backflips, jump onto platform, handstands, vertical pushups
takes.title: Backflips and handstand push-ups
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates standing resets and jumps with backward flips and upright handstands. The source identifies a platform jump and vertical push-ups in the sequence.

takes.title: Motorcycle stance with arms forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a staggered, slightly bent-knee stance with both arms extended forward at shoulder height, as if reaching for handlebars.

takes.sourceDescription: stretches, cartwheels, flips, spin kicks, spins, and fall
takes.title: Acrobatics sequence ending in a fall
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through lunges, turns, flips, and spinning kicks, drops backward to a sitting position, and rises again.

takes.title: Cartwheel straight into a backflip
takes.actionDescription: The take starts in a cartwheel-like turnover. The performer comes onto the feet, immediately jumps into a tucked backflip, and lands in a crouch.

takes.title: Jumping spin kick
takes.actionDescription: The performer winds up, jumps and turns with one leg extended sideways and the other bent, then lands and takes small recovery steps.

takes.title: Wide-leg cartwheel
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans sideways, sweeps the legs overhead in a wide split, and lands one foot at a time before lifting both arms.

takes.sourceDescription: crouch and flip backward on hands
takes.title: Crouch into a back handspring
takes.actionDescription: The performer dips into a crouch, springs backward onto both hands with the legs overhead, then returns to the feet and straightens.

takes.title: Low stretch into an inversion
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps into a low bend with one arm lifted, kicks the legs overhead through a hand-supported turnover, and steps out of the landing.

takes.title: Open-arm stretch and spin
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, steps through an upright turn with crossing feet, and settles with the hands near the waist.

takes.title: Stretch and repeat jumps
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends and reaches toward the floor, then springs up repeatedly with changing arm positions and steps out at the end.
